title: Single-HGT graph-ablation descriptive reporting protocol v1
status: rules fixed before new aggregate calculation; retrospective reporting correction using already-seen validation results, not a prospective experimental preregistration
authorization: Author approved next step after explanation: summarize existing single-HGT ablations now, defer manuscript placement to six-page adaptation
selection: all four conditions and all three single-seed rows per protocol; exclude three_seed_ensemble rows from new single-model aggregation; preserve legacy ensemble separately
aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of saved per-seed metric values; sample SD with denominator n-1=2; never metric of averaged predictions, never pooled confusion counts, never F1 recomputed from mean precision/recall
units: input metric ratios [0,1]; outputs retain full precision; presentation mean x100 in percent and SD x100 in percentage points; display 3 decimals only after calculation
primary: retain original raw validation AP as the primary ranking outcome and its already-saved paired uncertainty; secondary single-HGT OOF classification does not replace primary outcome
secondary: saved single-HGT component-isolated five-fold OOF calibration and threshold-selected metrics; one graph checkpoint per seed; no current recalibration or rethresholding
contrasts: Full minus each ablation for all six metrics under each protocol; descriptive mean of same-seed differences and per-seed directions only; no new contrast SD, CI, p-value, bootstrap or significance claims
uncertainty: new per-condition SD describes variation across three runs on the same validation population; it is not a CI or evidence of component significance; the original claim rule remains: stable direction plus corresponding paired uncertainty needed for supported component claim
legacy: verify original raw-AP summaries and saved intervals; archive old graph-ensemble point metrics and intervals with correct identity; read and keep existing same-seed 1-HGT+1-ModernBERT fusion summaries/intervals unchanged
verification: source hash and original audit/spec/freeze bindings
full graph single-seed crosscheck against P4 saved candidate CSV
cross-check computed means and sample SD with a separate numerical implementation
verify protected inputs and manuscript hashes after run
source_integrity_note: metrics CSV was located by saved audit but is not claimed to have been included in earlier 275-item seal selection; current hash matches 2026-10-20 inventory, with further lineage and P4/raw reconciliation required
